mapper.select: select mn.* from Archive_File mn left join Archive ar on ar.Ap_Id = mn.Ap_Id where mn.Af_State = 0 and ar.P_Id = #{pId}

select mn.Af_Id as afId, f.file_name as fileName, f.file_path as filePath, f.File_Location as fileLocation from Archive_File mn left join Sys_FileAnnex f on f.File_Id = mn.Af_Annex_Id where mn.Af_State = 1 and f.file_path is not null and (mn.Af_Index = false or mn.Af_Index is null) and lower(f.File_Suffix) in
lower(#{suffix})
limit 100

select pro.P_Name as pName, pro.P_Name_History as pNameHistory, pro.P_Code as pCode, pro.P_Agent_Construction_Unit as pAgentConstructionUnit, pro.P_Type as pType, pro.P_Use_Unit as pUseUnit, pro.P_Imp_Company as pImpCompany, pro.P_Competent_Department as pCompetentDepartment, pro.P_Construction_Unit as pConstructionUnit, pro.P_Approval_Unit as pApprovalUnit, pro.P_Build_Model as pBuildModel, pro.P_Each_District as pEachDistrict, pro.P_Inv_Total as pInvTotal, pro.P_Region as pRegion, pro.P_Project_Stage as pProjectStage, pro.P_Overview as pOverview, pro.P_Project_Code as pProjectCode, pro.P_Calculate_Roughly_Amount as pCalculateRoughlyAmount, pro.P_Advance_Fund as pAdvanceFund, pro.P_Corporate_Risk as pCorporateRisk, proc.C_Name as pConstructionUnitName, proc.C_Name as pConsName, proc.C_Abbreviation as pConsAbbName, pAgentc.C_Name as pAgentUnitName, prod.D_Name as pCompetentDepartmentName, prod.D_Name as pCompDepName, pro.P_Construction_Start as pConstructionStart, pro.P_Construction_End as pConstructionEnd, pro.P_Id as pId, ad.Ad_Id as adId, ad.Ad_Code as adCode, ad.Ad_Name as adName, ad.Ad_Link as adLink, ap.Ap_Title as apTitle, ap.Ap_Author as apAuthor, ap.Ap_Keyword as apKeyword, ap.Ap_Position as apPosition, ap.Ap_Document_No as apDocumentNo, ap.Ap_Written_Date as apWrittenDate, ap.Ap_Issue_Company as apIssueCompany, ap.Ap_Approval_Date as apApprovalDate, ap.Ap_Receipt_Time as apReceiptTime, sfa.File_Input_Version as fileInputVersion, sfa.file_create_u_id as fileCreateUid, sfa.file_create_u_name as fileCreateUname, mn.* from Archive_File mn left join Archive ap on mn.Ap_Id=ap.Ap_Id left join Archive_Directory ad on ap.Ad_Id=ad.Ad_Id left join Pre_Project pro on pro.P_Id=ap.P_Id left join SYS_FileAnnex sfa on sfa.file_id=mn.Af_Annex_Id left join SYS_Company proc on proc.C_Id=pro.P_Construction_Unit left join SYS_Company pAgentc on pAgentc.C_Id=pro.P_Agent_Construction_Unit left join SYS_Department prod on prod.D_Id=pro.P_Competent_Department where mn.Af_Id in
#{id}
